title: Large language models for computational social science
title_zh: 大型语言模型在计算社会科学中的应用
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are transforming computational social science. This Review examines how LLMs now serve four distinct research roles: subjects that simulate human behaviour, assistants that automate analysis, collaborators that generate hypotheses and evaluators that audit and improve research quality. We analyse recent advances across sociology, political science, psychology, anthropology, economics and related fields, revealing how LLMs accelerate discovery while creating new methodological paradigms. This transformation arrives as society itself becomes saturated with artificial intelligence agents—making LLMs both our research tools and authentic research subjects. Yet fundamental challenges persist. LLMs struggle with causal inference and raise urgent ethical concerns about privacy and misinformation, and their ability to reproduce social complexity remains uneven and unproven. We identify critical research directions for harnessing LLMs’ potential while addressing their limitations. As artificial intelligence reshapes human society, understanding this transformation requires the very tools driving it—a recursive challenge that will define the future of social science. This Review from Evans et al. documents the distinct roles that LLMs now have in computational social science and provides an overview of recent LLM-supported advances across fields including economics, psychology, political science, sociology and anthropology.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在转型计算社会科学。本综述考察了LLMs目前作为四种不同研究角色的表现：模拟人类行为的主体、自动化分析的助手、生成假设的合作者以及审计和提升研究质量的评估者。我们分析了社会学、政治学、心理学、人类学、经济学及相关领域的最新进展，揭示了LLMs如何加速发现并创造新的方法论范式。随着人工智能代理渗透至社会各个层面，LLMs既成为了研究工具，也成为了真实的研究对象。然而，根本性挑战依然存在。LLMs在因果推断方面存在困难，且引发了关于隐私和错误信息的紧迫伦理担忧，其再现社会复杂性的能力尚不均衡且尚未证实。我们确定了利用LLMs潜力同时解决其局限性的关键研究方向。随着人工智能重塑人类社会，理解这一转变需要驱动它的工具本身——这是一项递归性挑战，将定义社会科学的未来。Evans等人的这篇综述记录了LLMs在计算社会科学中现在的不同角色，并概述了包括经济学、心理学、政治学、社会学和人类学在内的领域中最近的LLM支持的进展。
